tools.name: verify_package
tools.description: Dependency Trust Oracle. Call this BEFORE writing any package into a manifest (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, ...). It checks whether the package actually exists on its registry, cross-references OSV.dev for known CVEs, pulls the package's OpenSSF Scorecard via deps.dev,

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_package · Public sink: verify_package.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_package · Public sink: verify_package

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
